content.comment_body: As mentioned in the title, how do I exit RUN mode on this [product_name] with [article_no]? Pressing the ESC button doesn't return me to the main menu where I could normally select STOP. The display only shows the inputs, system time, and outputs. I can access clock and parameter settings, but changes are blocked. Does anyone know if there’s a key combination to reset the unit? I don’t have the required PC software or cable, and online searches have been unsuccessful. Appreciate any help.
Hello, Try pressing OK and the arrow buttons at the same time, or possibly ESC along with the up and down arrows. It’s been a long time since I used a [article_no] module. Regards,
That worked! Using OK and the arrow buttons got me in. Thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced difficulty exiting RUN mode on an older [product_name] module without access to PC software or a cable, relying solely on the onboard controls. The lack of clear instructions for basic navigation caused frustration, but another user promptly provided the correct key combination to resolve the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipated being able to exit RUN mode, access STOP, and change settings directly through the device’s interface without needing extra software or hardware.
